macros.name: figcontents
macros.doc: Specify the contents of the figure by calling \figcontents{〈LaTeX commands〉}.

macros.name: figpageside
macros.doc: Calling \figpageside{}, i.e. with an empty argument, instructs fullpagefigure to use either side, whichever is more convenient.

macros.name: figpdf
macros.doc: The \figpdf command sets the PDF file to be displayed in full page (see more details below).

macros.name: figpdf
macros.doc: The \figpdf command sets the PDF file to be displayed in full page (see more details below).

macros.name: figplacement
macros.doc: Specify the figure caption placement with \figplacement{b|t|p}.

macros.name: FlushAllFullPageFigures
macros.doc: If you need to make sure that all full-page-figures have been placed up to a certain point, you may issue the command \FlushAllFullPageFigures.

macros.name: FlushAllFullPageFigures
macros.doc: If you need to make sure that all full-page-figures have been placed up to a certain point, you may issue the command \FlushAllFullPageFigures.

macros.name: fullpagefigurecaptionfmt

arg.snippet: fullpagefigurecaptionfmt{${1:page side O, E or x}}

macros.doc: The macro \fullpagefigurecaptionfmt is called to generate the text which is prepended to the figure caption.
